improvedPrompt:
Improved prompt:

[PROJECT OVERVIEW]
Create a single, highly detailed and realistic 3D render of a bald eagle's head and upper neck, looking upwards towards a prominent light source.

[SUBJECT SPECIFICATIONS]
- Subject: The head and upper neck of an adult bald eagle
- Count: Exactly one subject per composition
- Orientation: Profile view, facing left (viewer's right), with a steep upward tilt of approximately 70 degrees
- Pose or State: Static, with the neck fully extended and the head lifted upwards
- Expression: Neutral and majestic, maintaining the bird's natural dignity and presence

[SCALING AND PROPORTION]
- Subject to Frame Ratio: The eagle's head should occupy approximately 40% of the frame width and 30% of the frame height, positioned in the center-right
- Proportions: Maintain perfect anatomical accuracy in all facial features and feather detail
- Negative Space: Conserve extensive empty space on the left and bottom of the frame, with no distracting background elements

[COMPOSITIONAL ARRANGEMENT]
- Shot Type: Extreme close-up, filling the frame with the subject's head
- Camera Angle: Low angle, looking up at the subject's head from a slightly elevated position
- Framing: Position the subject in the right half of the frame, with its right side close to the frame edge
- Symmetry: The composition should be highly asymmetrical, with the light source entering from the top right and casting rays towards the bottom left
- Background: Utilize a completely pitch black background, with no visible elements or textures
- Depth of Field: Apply a deep focus effect, ensuring the light rays and illuminated subject features are pin-sharp

[TEMPORAL AND STYLISTIC CONTEXT]
- Era: Contemporary digital art, reflecting a modern 3D rendering aesthetic
- Modern Elements: Avoid incorporating any contemporary or stylized elements
- Retro Stylization: Preserve a literal and unadulterated representation
- Trend Influence: Do not incorporate current visual trends

[STYLE AND RENDERING TECHNIQUES]
- Visual Type: Pure 3D render, utilizing advanced lighting and materials
- Realism Level: Maximum texture realism, maintaining the highest level of physical accuracy
- Art Style: None, avoid any artistic interpretation or stylization
- Stylization: Maintain a literal and unaltered depiction of the subject
- Interpretation: Provide a faithful and unembellished reproduction of the eagle's head

[LIGHTING AND SHADING]
- Setup Type: Volumetric / rim lighting, using hard light sources to create dramatic contrast
- Light Direction: Primary light source entering from the top right, casting rays downwards towards the bottom left
- Light Quality: Hard volumetric beams (god rays), creating sharp and directional shadows
- Contrast: Extreme high contrast, utilizing a chiaroscuro effect to emphasize facial features and feather textures
- Shadow Behavior: Deep, absolute black shadows obscuring the lower half of the subject's head and neck
- Color Temperature: Very cool, monochromatic deep violet/purple tone, avoiding any warm or golden hues
- Lighting Variation: Maintain a consistent and unvaried lighting setup throughout the render

[MATERIALS AND SURFACE FINISH]
- Primary Materials: Focus on the feather textures and keratin (beak) surfaces
- Surface Finish: Matte feathers, with a semi-gloss beak finish to reflect the light
- Light Reflection: Accurately depict the sharp glint on the upper curve of the beak and soft highlights on individual feather edges
- Material Accuracy: Maintain exact and detailed representation of the subject's materials

[COLOR PALETTE AND TONING]
- Dominant Colors: Deep Purple (#32174d) as the primary light source color, with Black (#000000) as the background
- Saturation: High saturation in the purple light beams, maintaining vibrant and intense colors
- Contrast Level: Maximum contrast, ensuring clear distinction between lit and shadow areas
- Color Shift: Avoid any color shifts or alterations to the original tones

[TEXTURE AND DETAIL REFINEMENT]
- Surface Detail: Preserve fine feather barbs and textures only where the light hits, maintaining a clean and sharp appearance
- Grain Noise: None, render with a perfectly clean digital output
- Micro-details: Maintain the preserved beak texture and sharp edges of highlighted feathers
- Sharpness: Ensure sharp focus on the beak and top of the head, avoiding any softness or blur

[CAMERA SETTINGS AND RENDER QUALITY]
- Lens Equivalent: 50mm focal length, maintaining a natural perspective
- Perspective Distortion: None, avoid any optical distortions or wide-angle effects
- Aperture Look: f/8 (deep focus), ensuring both the subject and the light rays are in sharp focus
- Resolution: High, maintaining a detailed and clean output
- Render Quality: Clean and neutral, avoiding any artifacts or digital noise

[CONSTRAINTS AND PROHIBITED ELEMENTS]
- No Additional Objects: Exclude any other objects or elements in the frame
- No Reframing: Maintain the exact specified composition and framing
- No Crop: Avoid cropping or adjusting the frame dimensions
- No Stylization: Preserve a literal and unaltered representation
- No Artistic License: Refrain from any creative interpretations or embellishments
- No Text: Exclude any text or texturing elements
- No Watermark: Ensure no watermarks or brand markings appear in the render
- No Effects: Avoid applying any post-processing effects or adjustments
- No Dramatic Lighting: Maintain a consistent and unvaried lighting setup
- No Color Grading: Avoid any color grading or toning adjustments

[ITERATION INSTRUCTIONS]
- Compare to Reference: Utilize the provided reference image as a precise guide for geometry and lighting
- Fix Geometry First: Prioritize the anatomical accuracy and proportions of the eagle's head
- Then Fix Composition: Ensure the subject is positioned accurately within the frame
- Then Fix Lighting: Adjust the lighting setup to match the specified direction and quality
- Then Fix Color: Accurately represent the deep purple light and black background
- Ignore Aesthetic Improvements: Avoid any aesthetic enhancements or creative interpretations

[PROHIBITED STYLISTIC ELEMENTS]
- Creative, cinematic, artistic, stylized, illustration, abstract, dramatic, wide-angle, fisheye, exaggeration, reinterpretation, extra elements, modernized, retro look, color grading, AI artifacts, warm colors, visible background elements

[PROJECT DELIVERY]
- Provide a single, high-resolution render meeting the specified criteria
- Ensure the output adheres strictly to the constraints and instructions provided

[END]
